story.title: Shooting at D.C. Gym Leaves One Dead and Four Injured, Suspect Found Dead
story.summary: A shooting at a gym in Washington, D.C.'s Logan Circle resulted in one death and four injuries. The gunman reportedly opened fire both inside the gym and outside before barricading himself in a nearby building. Police later confirmed that the suspect is dead, having apparently turned the gun on himself.

timeline_highlights.summary: The 24-year-old suspect in a mass shooting in Krakow, Poland, which left six people dead and 15 injured, has died in hospital from injuries sustained during a shootout with police. Authorities are continuing their investigation into the incident, which occurred in a busy market square. Three bodies of the suspect's family members were also found at their home.

event_overview.title: About Krakow Shooting
event_overview.subject: Krakow Shooting
event_overview.summary: The Krakow shooting was a gun attack on 7 November 2026 in and around the Main Market Square in Krakow’s Old Town, Poland. Authorities reported six people killed and multiple people injured; the suspected attacker was shot and detained by police, while prosecutors opened a terrorism-related investigation.

facts.label: Date and location
facts.value: The attack occurred shortly after 3 p.m. on 7 November 2026 near Sławkowska Street by Krakow’s Main Market Square (Rynek Główny).

facts.label: Casualties
facts.value: Krakow city authorities reported six deaths and 15 injuries in the shooting.

facts.label: Suspect and police response
facts.value: The city said the alleged attacker, identified by police as a Polish citizen, was shot and detained by officers after the incident.

facts.label: Investigation
facts.value: The National Prosecutor’s Office opened an investigation covering the killing of six people in Krakow and attempted killings of others, including police officers; prosecutors described the Krakow act as a terrorism-related crime.

facts.label: Official mourning
facts.value: Poland declared national mourning for 8–9 November 2026 in tribute to the victims; Krakow separately announced city mourning through 11 November.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected timeline follows the shooting, the initial official assessment of possible far-right motives, and mourning measures, but does not attempt to cover every investigative development, victim update, or related incident.

explore_lenses.label: Was the shooting tied to a building dispute?
explore_lenses.title: A possible backdrop, not an established motive
explore_lenses.summary: Reporting identifies a preexisting condominium dispute involving the suspected shooter, but police had not publicly established that it caused the attack or explained the selection of victims.

claims.text: The Associated Press reported that authorities preliminarily identified the suspected shooter as Matt Lambert and that court records show he had sued his condominium building over alleged mold, moisture and water problems in his unit.
The civil case was still pending, with mediation reportedly scheduled for March 2027; that establishes an ongoing dispute but does not establish a motive for the shootings.
MPD interim chief Jeffery Carroll said further investigation was needed to determine whether the gunman and victims knew one another.

claims.text: Police said the first call came from inside VIDA Fitness at about 8 a.m., and Carroll said officers and emergency responders arrived within 30 seconds.
After leaving the gym area, the gunman barricaded himself in a nearby apartment building; police tried for about an hour to secure a surrender before hearing a gunshot, NPR reported.
The shelter-in-place order remained in effect until roughly 11:30 a.m.; nearby schools also went into lockdown and later resumed normal operations after police gave an all-clear, according to Axios.

story_report.summary: A shooting at VIDA Fitness in Washington’s Logan Circle left one man dead and four other people injured after a gunman fired inside and outside the gym. The suspected shooter later barricaded himself in a nearby apartment building and died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound after speaking with police negotiators. One injured person was reported in critical condition, while authorities continued to investigate the attack.

sections.heading: Emergency Response and Area Lockdown
sections.body: Police said the first call from inside VIDA Fitness came at about 8 a.m., and interim Chief Jeffery Carroll said officers and emergency responders arrived within 30 seconds. After the gunman left the gym area, police spent about an hour seeking his surrender at the nearby apartment building; a shelter-in-place order remained in place until roughly 11:30 a.m. Nearby schools entered lockdown before police issued an all-clear and normal operations resumed.

sections.heading: Pending Condominium Case Provides Background
sections.body: The Associated Press reported that authorities preliminarily identified the suspected shooter as Matt Lambert. Court records showed he had sued his condominium building over alleged mold, moisture and water problems in his unit, with the civil case still pending and mediation reportedly set for March 2027. The dispute establishes background but not a motive for the shootings.

sections.heading: Gym Closure Follows Fatal Shooting
sections.body: VIDA Fitness said its Logan Circle location would remain closed until further notice as recovery and access decisions continued. Police said some victims may have been struck at a construction site across the street, in addition to the man killed inside the gym, but investigators had not determined the exact locations where each person was shot.

unresolved.text: Investigators had not publicly identified a motive, explained how victims were selected, or confirmed whether the gunman knew any of the people shot or whether the condominium dispute was connected to the attack.
The precise sequence of gunfire, the locations where each injured person was struck, and a complete account of weapon evidence remained under investigation.
